title: 独立LLM与预设Agentic流水线在ICU死亡率预测解释中的可行性研究
summary: 本研究在eICU数据集上比较独立LLM与四步Agentic流水线解释ICU死亡率预测的效果。结果显示Agentic流水线在指南依据和患者特异性细节上更优，但SHAP对齐和方向一致性较低，建议结合归因检查用于高风险场景。
summary_en: This study compares a standalone LLM with a four-step agentic pipeline for explaining ICU mortality predictions on the eICU dataset. The agentic pipeline showed better guideline grounding and patient-specific detail but lower SHAP alignment and direction consistency, suggesting pairing with attribution checks for high-stakes use.
